verdict.detail: Same country, catalogue number and year as the first issue (UK, V 2013, 1974). Discogs lists 6 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
Recorded at The Manor in Spring 1974.

First UK pressing with the original stereo mix (post-1976 reissues featured the quad mix found on the 'Boxed' album). 
On front cover, the album's title and artist's name are on top.

This version was cut by

, Pete Norman and Melys (2).

and Melys (2), with slightly different cover (title on top and artist's name on bottom).

℗&© 1974 Virgin Records, 119 Portobello Road, London, W.11.

Runouts are stamped except for PETE & MELY and ARUN etchings.
